Hrishikesh Mohile: Use evidence-based production go/no-go reviews. Choice: Require named owners for unresolved reliability and security risks. Rationale: Visible ownership prevents critical risks from becoming assumptions. Outcome: All 9 synthetic launch risks had owners and evidence.
